title: Stage latency and memory with the encoder checkpoints resident
goal: Re-measure EXP-021 stage latency and memory with the encoder checkpoints resident. ONNX Runtime int8 is an allowed encoder runtime for a later measurement, not attempted here.
method: Identical 40 passages and bench() harness as EXP-021 (warm up once, then time repeated calls). ask_analyze/chunk stay rule code (unaffected by the encoder swap). search is RealIndex's bge dense channel; qa/nli are real_qa/real_nli; e2e runs engine.run_task with EXP-027's monkeypatch adapters in place. Peak RSS is the process high-water mark including every model load.

metrics.cpu_note: Measured on this process (CPU only, no GPU). RSS is peak resident set for the whole run, including every model load, not a per-model figure.

real_model_card.gliner_reason: the `gliner` package is not installed in this environment; dslim/bert-base-NER is the real checkpoint measured for the NER role instead

results_prose: Mean stage times in seconds with the encoder checkpoints resident: ask_analyze_sec 5.6e-05, chunk_sec 0.000876, bge_search_sec 0.03895, qa_sec 0.20792, nli_sec 37.245843, bge_embed_sec 0.106301, e2e_sec 116.210312. Peak RSS 1199.57 MB (EXP-021's lexical stack: 128.08 MB; e2e 0.039917s lexical vs 116.210312s here). deepset/deberta-v3-base-squad2, MoritzLaurer/DeBERTa-v3-base-mnli-fever-anli, and BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 are loaded; FLAN-T5/CTranslate2 are not.
conclusion: Loading three transformers/sentence-transformers checkpoints is measurably slower and heavier than the lexical substitutes EXP-021 timed -- that is the expected, honest cost of the real encoders on CPU, not a surprise, and quantized ONNX Runtime int8 (named by the todo as the allowed path to close that gap) is a follow-up, not run in this pass.
scale_down: Forty short passages, same as EXP-021. CTranslate2/FLAN-T5 are not timed (FORBIDDEN.md). ONNX Runtime int8 quantization is not applied in this pass.
follow_ups: Quantize these three checkpoints with ONNX Runtime int8 and rerun this same bench() harness for the latency/memory figure the todo actually asks for.
models_used: deepset/deberta-v3-base-squad2, MoritzLaurer/DeBERTa-v3-base-mnli-fever-anli, BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5, plain transformers/sentence-transformers (no quantization). Local checkpoints, not API calls. Not generative.
